name: irrigationsystem
description: HomeKit irrigation system using HAP-NodeJS library
author: n0rt0nthec4t

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs src/HomeKitDevice/HomeKitDevice.test.js src/HomeKitHistory/HomeKitHistory.test.js src/HomeKitUI/HomeKitUI.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage tests/*.test.mjs src/HomeKitDevice/HomeKitDevice.test.js src/HomeKitHistory/HomeKitHistory.test.js src/HomeKitUI/HomeKitUI.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run clean && copyfiles -u 1 src/*.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 src/HomeKitDevice/*.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 src/HomeKitHistory/*.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 src/HomeKitUI/*.js dist && copyfiles -u 2 "src/HomeKitUI/ui/**" dist && copyfiles config.schema.json dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run format && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
